#!/bin/bash

#SBATCH --job-name=Infer-t5-ESCOV
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --account=glucas_540
#SBATCH --partition=gpu
#SBATCH --ntasks-per-node=1
#SBATCH --gres=gpu:v100:1
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=10
#SBATCH --time=30:00:00
#SBATCH --exclusive
#SBATCH --mem=20G
#SBATCH --output=slogs/%j.%x.info.log
#SBATCH --error=slogs/%j.%x.error.log


export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
export OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=2


# setup
module purge
module load conda
eval "$(conda shell.bash hook)"
conda activate /project/glucas_540/briank/kemi-env

# set env for torch run
export MASTER_PORT=`comm -23 <(seq 49152 65535 | sort) <(ss -Htan | awk '{print $4}' | cut -d':' -f2 | sort -u) | shuf | head -n 1`
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/spack/conda/miniconda3/23.3.1/lib/:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH
export MASTER_ADDR=$(scontrol show hostnames "$SLURM_JOB_NODELIST" | head -n 1)

# GPU Spec
echo "CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES: $CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"
nvidia-smi

# run
echo ""
echo "Running Baseline Experiment"
echo ""

# wandb information
source "$PWD/_wandb.sh"


job_id=$SLURM_JOB_ID
experiment_nm=${job_id}.${SLURM_JOB_NAME}
python infer.py \
    --config_name emp_dialog_t5 \
    --inputter_name emp_dialog_t5 \
    --data_name esconv \
    --knowledge_name sbert \
    --add_nlg_eval \
    --add_mi_analysis \
    --seed 13 \
    --load_checkpoint ./DATA/emp_dialog_t5.emp_dialog_t5.esconv.sbert/2023-10-31154507.3e-05.16.1gpu/epoch-9.bin \
    --fp16 false \
    --max_input_length 256 \
    --max_decoder_input_length 40 \
    --max_length 40 \
    --min_length 15 \
    --infer_batch_size 2 \
    --infer_input_file ./_reformat/ \
    --temperature 0.7 \
    --top_k 30 \
    --top_p 0.3 \
    --num_beams 1 \
    --repetition_penalty 1 \
    --no_repeat_ngram_size 3

echo "DONE"

issues: The output and error log directory 'slogs/' must exist before the job is submitted, otherwise the job will fail to start.

There is a potential mismatch in CPU resource allocation and usage. The job requests 10 CPUs via `--cpus-per-task=10` but then programmatically limits `OMP_NUM_THREADS=1` and `OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=2`. This could lead to underutilization of the allocated CPUs unless the Python script is specifically configured to use multiple processes for data loading.
The script sources a local file: `source "$PWD/_wandb.sh"`. This requires the file `_wandb.sh` to be present and correctly configured in the directory from which the `sbatch` command is executed.

The logic to find and export `MASTER_PORT` and `MASTER_ADDR` is typically used for multi-node, multi-GPU distributed training. For a single-node, single-GPU job (`--nodes=1`, `--ntasks-per-node=1`), it is unnecessary and adds complexity without providing any benefit.

The script uses relative paths for crucial files (e.g., `--load_checkpoint`, `--infer_input_file`). This makes the script dependent on the submission directory. Using absolute paths or paths relative to `$SLURM_SUBMIT_DIR` is a more robust practice.
